verses.text: <pb/>Ma Joshua ghọrọ agadi, ubọchi ndu-ya nāgwu; Jehova we si ya, I ghọwo agadi, ubọchi ndu-gi nāgwu, ma ala nke riri nne nke-uku fọduru inweta.
Nka bu ala nke fọduru: buruburu-ala nile nke ndi Filistia, na ndi Geshua nile;

site na Shaihoa ahu, nke di n'iru Ijipt, we rue ókè-ala Ekron n'akuku Ugwu, ndi Kenean ka aguru ya nye: ndi-isi ise nke ndi Filistia; ndi Geza, na ndi Ashdod, na ndi Ashkelon, na ndi Gat, na ndi Ekron; ndi Avim kwa,
site na Ndida: ala nile nke ndi Kenean, na Meara nke ndi Zaidon nwe, rue Efek, rue ókè-ala ndi-Amorait:
na ala ndi Gebal, na Lebanon nile, n'ọwuwa-anyanwu, site na Beal-gad n'okpuru ugwu Heamon rue nbata Hemat:
ndi nile bi n'ugwu site na Lebanon rue Mizrefot-maim, bú ndi Zaidon nile; Mu onwem nānapu ha ala-ha n'iru umu Israel: nání me ka ọ dayere Israel n'ihe-nketa, dika M'nyeworo gi iwu.
Ma ub͕u a kère ebo iteghete na nkera ebo Manase ala nka n'ihe-nketa.
Ndi Reuben na ndi Gad soro ya nara ihe-nketa-ha, nke Moses nyere ha, n'ofè Jọdan n'akuku ọwuwa-anyanwu, dika Moses, bú orù Jehova, nyere ha;
site n'Aroea, nke di n'usọ ndagwurugwu Anon, na obodo nke di n'etiti ndagwurugwu ahu, na ala di lari nile nke Medeba rue Dibon;
na obodo nile nke Saihon, bú eze ndi-Amorait, onye buri eze nime Heshbon, rue ókè-ala umu Amon;
na Gilead, na ókè-ala ndi Geshua na ndi Meakat, na ugwu Heamon nile, na Beshan nile rue Saleka;
ala-eze nile nke Og nime Beshan, onye buri eze n'Ashtarot na n'Edrei (onye ahu fọduru site na ndi fọduru nke Refaim); Moses we tib͕ue ha, napu ha ala-ha.
Ma umu Israel anapughi ndi Geshua na ndi Meakat ala-ha: Geshua na Meakat we biri n'etiti umu Israel, rue ta.
Nání ebo Livai ka ọ nēnyeghi ihe-nketa; àjà-ọku nile nke Jehova, bú Chineke Israel, nke ahu bu ihe-nketa-ya, dika Ọ gwara ya okwu.
<pb/>Moses we nye ebo umu Reuben dika ab͕uru nile ha si di.
Ókè-ala ha nwere we di site n'Aroea, nke di n'usọ ndagwurugwu Anon, na obodo nke di n'etiti ndagwurugwu ahu, na ala di lari nile nke di n'akuku Medeba;
Heshbon, na obodo-ya nile nke di n'ala di lari; Dibon, na Bamot-beal, na Bet-beal-meon;
na Jehaz, na Kedimot, na Mefaat;
na Kiriataim, na Sibma, na Zeret-shaha n'ugwu ndagwurugwu ahu;
na Bet-peoa, na nkpọrube nile nke Pisga, na Bet-jeshimot;

na obodo nile nke ala di lari, na ala-eze nile nke Saihon, bú eze ndi-Amorait, onye buri eze nime Heshbon, onye Moses tib͕uru, ya na ndi-isi Midian, bú Evi, na Rekem, na Zua, na Hua, na Reba, ndi bu ndi-isi nke Saihon, ndi bi n'ala ahu.
Umu Israel were kwa mma-agha b͕ue Belam nwa Beoa, bu onye nāju ase, n'etiti ndi ha b͕uru.
Òkè-ala umu Reuben we buru Jọdan, na ókè-ala-ya. Nka bu ihe-nketa umu Reuben dika ab͕uru nile ha si di, obodo nile na obodo ntà nile ha.
<pb/>Moses we nye ebo Gad, bú umu Gad, dika ab͕uru nile ha si di.
Ókè-ala-ha we buru Jeza, na obodo nile nke Gilead, na nkera ala umu Amon, rue Aroea nke di n'iru Raba;
site kwa na Heshbon rue Remat-mizpe, na Betonim; site kwa na Mahanaim rue ókè-ala Debia;

na nime ndagwurugwu ahu, Bet-heram, na Bet-nimra, na Sukot, na Zafon, bú nke fọduru nke ala-eze Saihon, bú eze Heshbon, Jọdan na ókè-ala-ya, rue nsọtu oké osimiri Kineret n'ofè Jọdan n'akuku ọwuwa-anyanwu.
Nka bu ihe-nketa umu Gad dika ab͕uru nile ha si di, obodo nile na obodo ntà nile ha.
<pb/>Moses we nye nkera ebo Manase ihe-nketa: ọ we diri nkera ebo umu Manase dika ab͕uru nile ha si di.
Ókè-ala-ya we di site na Mahanaim, Beshan nile, ala-eze nile nke Og, bú eze Beshan, na ebe-obibi nile nke Jaia, nke di na Beshan, ọgu obodo atọ:
nkera Gilead, na Ashtarot, na Edrei, bú obodo ala-eze Og nime Beshan, we diri umu Makia nwa Manase, diri nkera umu Makia dika ab͕uru nile ha si di.
<pb/>Ndia bu ndi Moses mere ka ha keta ihe n'ala ihe nādighi nke Moab, n'ofè Jọdan n'akuku Jeriko, n'akuku ọwuwa-anyanwu.
Ma Moses enyeghi ebo Livai ihe-nketa: Jehova, bú Chineke Israel, bu ihe-nketa-ha, dika Ọ gwara ha okwu.
